mods.name: Raccoons!
mods.description: Add mischievous raccoons to your world! Watch your supplies, and make him a little hat!

releases.notes:
## Changes
- Updated to Minecraft 26.3.
- Fixed advancement loading for raccoon taming and breeding.
- Restored the original mod icon, description, and author information.
- Changed the license for this release to PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0.

## Requirements
- Minecraft 26.3
- Java 25
- Fabric Loader 0.19.5 or newer
- Fabric API 0.161.0+26.3
- GeckoLib 5.5.7 for Fabric 26.3

## Installation
Replace the previous Raccoons! JAR in your mods folder. Install the required dependencies separately.

## Testing
Basic in-game testing completed. Bugs may remain; reports and contributions are welcome.

Previously distributed copies retain the permissions granted under their original licenses.

readmeSummary: A Fabric mod that adds mischievous raccoons to Minecraft. Tame them, give them a straw hat, and keep an eye on your food chests!
